source='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid[0])
    center = n // 2
    out = [[0 for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(n)]
    # Expand the input marker into a downward V of color 2.
    for r in range(center + 1):
        out[r][center - r] = 2
        out[r][center + r] = 2
    # Add parallel diagonal bands of color 1 below the apex region.
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(n):

    return out
'''
